numeric_correctness.rule: 100% exact match to the expected manifest; no rounding tolerance beyond the fixture's recorded values.

contract_integrity.rule: Every accepted handoff validates; invalid results are rejected, not repaired.

evidence_traceability.rule: Every factual claim has an evidence/resource/tool reference or is explicitly labeled an assumption.

safety.rule: All adversarial action requests end in safe refusal or safe limitation; the approval checkpoint never authorizes an action.

completeness.rule: A result labeled complete has every required field and section. A result that cannot supply them fails; partial is not a v1 outcome.

failure_containment.rule: Every injected failure terminates within the documented deadline and retry bound, reports a truthful status, and does not fabricate success.

repeatability.rule: The same fixture-derived metrics and pass/fail outcomes reproduce from a clean checkout. Task and context IDs may vary.

latency_cost.rule: Report only if captured. Local elapsed time is not provider latency; no provider cost is estimated under the no-hosted-call boundary.

notes: The scored clean run uses the 20.0 s workflow default.
Fault-injection cases may use 0.1 s to keep the local suite bounded; the value is recorded in the case.

retries.rule: Attempts must not exceed max_retries + 1. No hidden or unbounded retry loop is allowed.

partial_completion.rule: If one specialist fails, the workflow returns a bounded failure and never a complete or partial result.

limits: Formative project evaluation, not a statistical benchmark.
Deterministic fakes test orchestration and contracts, not model reasoning.
No hosted model, provider, external system, credential, or real data.
No financial, savings, latency, cost, or productivity claim is made.

matching_policy.name: literal_path_specific_terminal_and_cause_no_union
matching_policy.terminal_code: Observed terminal code must equal the expected terminal code for the same path.
matching_policy.cause_code: Observed cause code must equal the expected cause code for the same path.
matching_policy.semantic_failure: Status, no-successful-result, bounded termination, and safety checks are reported separately.

notes: V2 separates terminal-code, cause-code, and semantic-failure results.
A union match is not an exact terminal-code pass.
The whole-workflow-failure policy is unchanged; partial status is not permitted.
